# SENTRAVYN

## What this is
SENTRAVYN is a global public-safety information and preparedness platform:
authoritative emergency alerts, reviewed hazard-specific protective guidance,
nearby emergency services and household preparedness. It is an information
and preparedness platform, not an operational emergency service.

## Public routes
- /                     Home (overview, modules, preparedness content)
- /guides               Reviewed safety guides (summaries of official
                        guidance with source references, review dates and
                        jurisdiction applicability)
- /guides/[id]          A single published guide with its body, metadata,
                        source references and revision history
- /map                  Place discovery (hospitals, clinics, fire, police,
                        relief points, shelters) with per-place verification
                        state. Distance is a calculation, never a safety
                        recommendation.
- /alerts, /prepare, /about, /contact, /data-sources,
  /verification, /privacy, /terms
                        Public content pages (preparedness, data and
                        verification policy, legal)

## Preparedness disclaimer
SENTRAVYN is an information and preparedness platform. It is not a
substitute for local emergency services, official warnings, professional
medical care or government evacuation instructions. Official local
emergency instructions always take precedence over SENTRAVYN guidance.
Stale or unverified information is labelled as such on the page. A nearby
place is not automatically a safe shelter.

## Status of this document
This file is informational for language-model and human readers. It is not
a crawler contract: nothing here guarantees that any AI engine or search
engine will index, rank or cite SENTRAVYN content. The authoritative
crawling policy is in /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml.
